card.name: Modal verbs in policy statements
card.fires_on: Words like must, need, should, will or have right after a subject such as we or those, in formal policy or speech text about what ought to be done.

modes.label: Obligation verbs
modes.description: Modal or need verbs after a subject in a call to action.
modes.example: Fourth, we<< must>> embark on a bold new program for making

modes.label: Words inside the stated aim
modes.description: Words in the middle of a goal phrase in a speech or policy text.
modes.example: In the past century the Church has grown both extensively and intens<<ively>> among English-speaking peoples.

card.plain: It fires on words like must, need or should in formal statements about what people ought to do.
